The Aurora product launch date is confirmed for April 12th, with the press embargo lifting at 9 AM Eastern that day.
An Android 12 image-upload crash is the only P0/P1 blocker; David Kim's team is investigating and will report status by Wednesday March 18th at 5 PM.
If the Android crash root cause is not identified by Wednesday, the fallback plan is to disable image upload on affected devices for launch.
Code freeze is set for March 20th, with a single exception granted for the Android image-upload fix only.
The product demo video depends on updated screenshots from engineering; James O'Brien will deliver the final video to Lisa Patel by Friday March 20th.
Rachel Torres will run a full end-to-end QA regression pass during the week of March 23rd, requiring the code freeze to hold.
A go/no-go review meeting is to be scheduled for March 25th by Sarah Chen.
